data-z01-20.title: 2019 scenes, UTM zones 1–20
data-z01-20.description: The archive of the year for UTM zones 1 to 20. The build splits a year into zone parts because a whole year of this collection does not fit the disk of the runner that sorts it. GeoParquet 2.0, with a native Parquet GEOMETRY column in OGC:CRS84 and one row per upstream Earth Search item.
